This beta has no Apple Developer ID signature or notarization. Models download on first use. Translation can be wrong; speed depends on your computer.

Install and get started

  1. Open the DMG, drag VocaLume into Applications, then launch it there and download the models. If macOS blocks it, verify the source and review System Settings → Privacy & Security. Do not disable system-wide security.

  2. Extract the extension ZIP to a permanent folder. Open chrome://extensions in Chrome or opera://extensions in Opera GX. Enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the folder containing manifest.json.

  3. Connect the extension to your installed VocaLume app for local Mac browser captions. Copy the extension ID from the extension manager. In Terminal, type cd followed by a space, drag in the extracted extension folder, then press Enter. Replace YOUR_EXTENSION_ID below with your ID and run the command.

    ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 '/Applications/VocaLume.app/Contents/MacOS/VocaLume' desktop/install-mac.cjs YOUR_EXTENSION_ID

  4. Reload the extension and refresh the video page. Play a video, choose the desktop app and languages in Live captions, then start. Wait for initial model loading. Confirm both source and translated text appear. Do not start capture from the app and extension simultaneously.
